Long, flowing, raven-black hair with heavy bangs framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped, emerald-green eyes. Appears as a mature adult in her early 30s with a slender, hourglass build. Wears a gothic, high-collared black velvet dress with intricate lace detailing and a deep purple lining. Signature traits include a wide-brimmed pointed hat and various mystical amulets.
